review_scope: Read-only direct source/scope/sensitivity review for lexical indexes 0 through 125 in the reconciliation ledger’s 252 paths with aggregate-only coverage and no direct path review row.

review_method.automated_patterns: Counts only; matched values are not copied into output.
review_method.semantic_scope: All selected paths are under .agent/evidence or .agent/gates. Content scope is internal execution, verification, reconciliation, review, or gate evidence; no product/runtime source or package manifest occurs in this tranche.

limitations: Pattern scanning can have false positives and false negatives.

The CPF check counts only explicit dotted/spaced forms and unformatted 11-digit values that pass check-digit validation after excluding long hexadecimal hashes; checksum validity is not provenance or identity proof.
No reliable generic person-name recognition was performed; a narrow person-name field-label scan is reported but does not prove absence of names.
URL scans count shapes only; they do not validate ownership, destination, or intent.
This review does not approve or assemble any candidate.
snapshot_artifact_note: This artifact was created after the reconciliation snapshot and after reading the selected paths; it is not part of the source snapshot and must be included in a later worktree refresh.
